def clear_and_type(x,y,text):
    click_at_xy(x,y)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', modifiers=2, commands=['selectAll'])
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA', modifiers=2)
    press_key('Backspace')
    if text: type_text(text)
